structure <NAMESPACE>State where
  stateVersion : Nat
  theoryVersion : Nat
  evidenceVersion : Nat
  experimentVersion : Nat
  dependencyVersion : Nat

def accepts (x : <NAMESPACE>State) (pkg : ByteArray) : Prop :=
  independentChecker x pkg = Verdict.accept

theorem incremental_eq_cold
  (hComplete : dependencyComplete x)
  (hDet : deterministicDerivations x) :
  incrementalRelease x = coldRelease x := by
  induction dependencyTopologicalOrder x with
  | nil => simp [incrementalRelease, coldRelease]
  | cons u us ih => simp [incrementalRelease, coldRelease, hComplete, hDet, ih]
